lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `homework_api.check_pupil_code(entered_code text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/check_pupil_code`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `homework_api.get_current_pupil_homework(entered_code text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/get_current_pupil_homework`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `homework_api.open_pupil_question(entered_attempt_id uuid, entered_attempt_token uuid)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/open_pupil_question`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `homework_api.start_pupil_quiz(entered_code text, entered_quiz_id uuid)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/start_pupil_quiz`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `homework_api.submit_pupil_answer(entered_attempt_id uuid, entered_attempt_token uuid, entered_answer integer)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/submit_pupil_answer`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
